info.name: Get a list of all venues

params.name: acadYear
params.description: academic year, with the slash (/) replaced by a dash

params.name: semester
params.description: semester, with 1 and 2 representing semester 1 and 2, and 3, 4 representing special term 1 and 2

items.docs: Get a list of all venues, including lecture theatres, seminar rooms, laboratories, etc. used in the given semester's classes. This endpoint only returns an array of names, and is useful for searching and autocompletion.

info.name: Get detailed information on all venues

params.name: acadYear
params.description: academic year, with the slash (/) replaced by a dash

params.name: semester
params.description: semester, with 1 and 2 representing semester 1 and 2, and 3, 4 representing special term 1 and 2

items.docs: Get detailed venue information including classes and occupancy for every venue. This is useful for displaying a timetable of the given venue as well as for checking if a venue is occupied at any given time.
